protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

support.scope: Pinned BlueRoseLabs/Silencio-2 checkpoint and its eight bundled voice catalog entries; this benchmark exposes only synthetic voice 260.
support.notes: English only. The browser configuration uses voice 260, carries its model-bound state, and does not expose custom voice cloning or the other seven catalog entries. CPU/WASM and WebGPU run FP32 ONNX graphs with one WASM thread; WebGPU allows WASM operator fallback and must prove actual GPU dispatch. Seeded browser noise is disclosed and is not bitwise PyTorch RNG parity.

cells.precision: FP32 ONNX graphs; one-thread CPU/WASM or WebGPU with WASM operator fallback.

settings.executionScheduling: All ONNX Runtime session runs are serialized inside the worker.
settings.randomSeed: Seed 0 per canonical source span; Mulberry32 + Box-Muller normal noise, scaled by sqrt(0.3); not bitwise PyTorch RNG parity.
settings.frontend: Pinned Silencio-2 prompt preparation, tag validation, SentencePiece-equivalent Unigram IDs and sentence/fallback chunking; 48 IDs is the soft chunking target and the official 50-token generator capacity is enforced.
settings.generation: Official drifting flow, EOS threshold, minimum frame and text-dependent EOS tail; raw unnormalized Float32 stream at 24 kHz.
settings.voiceState: Precomputed state from the official bundled synthetic voice 260 WAV and pinned model checkpoint.
settings.outputLocation: Every ONNX run is awaited; PCM is copied to worker CPU Float32Arrays before return.
settings.browserNoise: Mulberry32 + Box-Muller, seed 0 per source span

capability.description: Observed 306177 actual WebGPU compute dispatches during separate untimed synthesis. WebGPU with WASM operator fallback; CPU-readable PCM. Hooks removed before scored generation.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
